items.title: Lemon Nash Interview, 1960-09-28
items.q: I used to be with the big Indian man. And Western Cowboy. You know selling medicine.

ctx.x: In the months of May, a sunny day, a boyly bum come hiking down the shady land to the sugar can. He was looking for his liking. And he rolled along and he sung a song with a blend of milk and honey. Where a bum can stay for many of days. And he don't need any money. Of the button of the bees and the cigarette trees. So the water fountain. The lemonade spring. Where's the bluebird sing? In the big rock candy mountain. And then on the run come a fireman's son. Through the hay field he was abounding. Says the bum to…
Well who taught it to you?
